messages.subject: Re: Plot() error when using sim object
parts: Incidentally, that same chose should have worked without @.envir . Plot never worked for highly nested objects. The new fix I think should allow that. There is one limitation still: sim$obj and sim@.envir@obj will not plot on the same plot location on the device, because it is finding plot location by name.
